comments.author: PepperdineG
comments.why: Abdopus aculeatus hunts crabs on land, narrated by Attenborough
comments.text: >Octopuses are very much a water-only type of organism. They're not though. Octopi generally don't like being out of water, but they're capable of traveling on land short distances and in fact the Abdopus Aculeatus octopus regularly goes on land by choice in order to hunt crabs in different tidepools. Sir David Attenborough discusses the octopus here, which this octopus was one of the animals featured in The Hunt documentary: [VIDEO]
